claude.text:
## Assessment

All 19 folds degenerate with zero exposure — this is an uninitialized or over-regularized baseline. The unified_baseline likely needs hyperparameter relaxation or signal verification before any meaningful optimization can proceed.

## Next Commands (3 lines)

```
ost diag signal-check --lane ost_v62_unified --folds 1-5 --verbose
ost sweep --lane ost_v62_unified --param l1_ratio --range 0.0,0.3 --steps 5 --seeds 3
ost train --lane ost_v62_unified --config relaxed_reg --checkpoint baseline_v1
```

gpt.text:
```bash
aub diagnose --lane ost_v62_unified --run unified_baseline --cv --report folds,exposure,signals,filters --out reports/diag_unified_baseline.json
aub backtest --lane ost_v62_unified --run unified_baseline --override filters=off,trade_threshold=0,cost_bps=0 --out reports/sanity_no_gates/
aub train --lane ost_v62_unified --run debug_exposure_v1 --cv 20 --override trade_threshold=0,filters=light,position_target=vol_target --out runs/debug_exposure_v1/
```

If these don’t match your CLI exactly, tell me the actual command names/flags your AUB runner supports (or paste `aub --help`), and I’ll rewrite them precisely. The intent is: (1) confirm *where* exposure is being zeroed (model outputs vs. gating/risk filters), (2) run a “no-gates” sanity backtest to prove the signal can trade, (3) re-run CV with relaxed gating to eliminate the degenerate folds.
